text.body: piṇḍopaniṣat oṃ devatā ṛṣayaḥ sarve brahmāṇamidamabruvan | mṛtasya dīyate piṇḍaṃ kathaṃ gṛhṇantyacetasaḥ || bhinne pañcātmake dehe gate pañcasu pañcadhā | haṃsastvastvā gato dehaṃ kasmin sthāne vyavasthitaḥ || tryahaṃ vasati toyeṣu tryahaṃ vasati cāgniṣu | tryahamākāśago bhūtvā dinamekantu vāyugaḥ || prathamena tu piṇḍena kalānāṃ tasya sambhavaḥ | dvitīyena tu piṇḍena māsatvakcchoṇitodbhavaḥ || tṛtīyena tu piṇḍena matistasyābhijāyate | caturthena tu piṇḍena asthi majjā prajāyate || pañcamena tu piṇḍena hastāṅgulyaḥ śiro mukham | ṣaṣṭhena kṛtapiṇḍena hṛtkaṇṭhaṃ tālu jāyate || saptamena tu piṇḍena dīrghamāyuḥ prajāyate | aṣṭamena tu piṇḍena vācaṃ puṣyati vīryavān || navamena tu piṇḍena sarvendriyasamāhṛtiḥ | daśamena tu piṇḍena bhāvanaṃ plāvanaṃ tathā | piṇḍe piṇḍe śarīrasya piṇḍadānena sambhavaḥ || iti piṇḍopaniṣat samāptā
